podcast.title: Overton Park Shell Concert (June 1)
podcast.body: Warren Smith performed at the Overton Park Shell in Memphis on Friday, June 1, at 8 p.m., as part of a country rock and roll show. He shared the stage with Kyle Perkins, Johnny Cash, Roy Orbison, and Eddie Bond and the Stumpers. "Rock and roll Ruby with Warren Smith, the new sensation Roy Orbison is team Kings with the Ubidubi."

xref.title: Overton Park Shell Concert (June 1)
xref.body: Kyle Perkins, billed as "Mr. Blue Swade Shoes" and fresh from the Pericomo TV show, headlined a country rock and roll show at the Overton Park Shell in Memphis on Friday, June 1, at 8 p.m. He performed alongside other notable artists like Johnny Cash, Warren Smith, Roy Orbison, and Eddie Bond and the Stumpers. "Kyle Perkins will rock and roll in the Overton Park show for a great show Friday night, the first to June 8 p.m."
